# Arc layout, long lines on 3-5 rows with commas and tiny words: no word may touch a word of a row above it,
# also two rows up past a short row. Compare a branch with main by running it twice.
# Run: gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref main -f version=26.3 -f mod_ref=<branch or commit> -f script=.github/checks/arc-rows.txt

cmd weather clear
cmd time set midnight
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
set layout ARC
look 0 -20
sleep 6
lines Lanterns glowing over every quiet hill tonight, oh, I, lanterns glowing over every quiet hill tonight | Wide rivers singing, a, o, wide rivers singing through the endless silver valley below | We run, oh, we run, a, I, through the bright and burning neon streets until the morning finds us
seek 0
sleep 4
shot arc-rows-g2-a
sleep 4
shot arc-rows-g2-b
sleep 4
shot arc-rows-g2-c
guiscale 3
seek 0
sleep 4
shot arc-rows-g3-a
sleep 4
shot arc-rows-g3-b
sleep 4
shot arc-rows-g3-c
